description: Live your best life with WonderWink! We're always working to bring you innovative and stylish scrubs and the High Waist Power Pant in the RENEW collection is all of that! Imagine your favorite leggings and then just think that could be a scrub pant! The WonderWink RENEW Women's High Waist Power Scrub Pant offers the perfect hybrid legging/scrub pants! The high waist offers a tummy control and style, while the pockets offer a place to keep a few select items close at hand. The fit is designed to be similar to a legging so it's more tight fitting than a classic scrub pant and the fabric is a polyster so the fabric moves with you. The fabric is a sustainable blend of polyester, recycled polyester, and spandex so comfort and feel is amazing while the scrub pants move with you! Modern, slimming, and very stylish this scrub pant checks all the boxes!
